From abbf9a0ef8848dca58c5b97750c1c59bbee45637 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2021 17:34:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] r8169: fix r8168fp_adjust_ocp_cmd function

The (0xBAF70000 & 0x00FFF000) << 6 should be (0xf70 << 18).

Fixes: 561535b0f239 ("r8169: fix OCP access on RTL8117")
Signed-off-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com>
Acked-by: Heiner Kallweit <hkallweit1@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/realtek/r8169_main.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/realtek/r8169_main.c
index f704da3f214c..7aad0ba53372 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/realtek/r8169_main.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/realtek/r8169_main.c
@@ -767,7 +767,7 @@ static void r8168fp_adjust_ocp_cmd(struct rtl8169_private *tp, u32 *cmd, int typ
 	if (type == ERIAR_OOB &&
 	    (tp->mac_version == RTL_GIGA_MAC_VER_52 ||
 	     tp->mac_version == RTL_GIGA_MAC_VER_53))
-		*cmd |= 0x7f0 << 18;
+		*cmd |= 0xf70 << 18;
 }
 
 DECLARE_RTL_COND(rtl_eriar_cond)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `r8169_main.c`**
- The line of code within the `r8168fp_adjust_ocp_cmd` function was modified. Specifically, the expression `*cmd |= 0x7f0 << 18;` was changed to `*cmd |= 0xf70 << 18;`. This change corrects the value being set in the command based on the condition that checks the `type` and `mac_version`.

### Relationships
- The modification in `r8169_main.c` addresses a bug related to the OCP access on the RTL8117, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit (`561535b0f239`). The change ensures that the command adjustment is performed correctly, which is crucial for the proper functioning of the driver. The patch is signed off by multiple contributors, indicating collaborative validation of the fix.

r8169: fix r8168fp_adjust_ocp_cmd function

The (0xBAF70000 & 0x00FFF000) << 6 should be (0xf70 << 18).

Fixes: 561535b0f239 ("r8169: fix OCP access on RTL8117")
Signed-off-by: Hayes Wang <hayeswang@realtek.com>
Acked-by: Heiner Kallweit <hkallweit1@gmail.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect bitwise operation in the `r8168fp_adjust_ocp_cmd` function, where the value `0x7f0` was used instead of the correct value `0xf70`. This mistake led to improper command adjustments for the OCP access on the RTL8117, potentially causing malfunctioning of the network driver.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void r8168fp_adjust_ocp_cmd(struct rtl8169_private *tp, u32 *cmd, int type)
 {
 	/* based on RTL8168FP_OOBMAC_BASE in vendor driver */
 	if (type == ERIAR_OOB &&
 	    (tp->mac_version == RTL_GIGA_MAC_VER_52 ||
 	     tp->mac_version == RTL_GIGA_MAC_VER_53))
-		*cmd |= 0x7f0 << 18;
+		*cmd |= 0xf70 << 18;
 }
